convention: canvas pixels, boxes [left, top, right, bottom) with right/bottom exclusive
method: Derived from source-authored geometry and TEMPLATE_V3, never from the masks. Standing frames: head = the bounding box of the frame's hair (and facial hair) envelopes, widened by head_margin.side, raised by head_margin.top, widened on the front side by head_margin.front_extra_E for E, and extended down by the age's neck rows (the deepest owner face/neck skin support below its hair box, plus neck_margin_rows); legs = from the age's hip row to the foot line across the figure (figure = alpha >= 16 outside prop polygons); hip row = the highest owner leg skin support of that age (S/idle) minus hip_margin_rows (TEMPLATE_V3 gives walk/work/carry the S/idle scale and foot line); arms = the shoulder band (every figure row down to the head box's bottom: raised hands, a log held behind the head, an axe overhead) plus, for S, the figure left and right of the age's torso core from the figure top to the hip row (core = from the rightmost column of any left forearm/arm to the leftmost column of any right one over the anatomy forearm boxes and owner arm skin supports of every look of the age, narrowed by torso_core_margin), for E, the figure from the head box's left edge rightwards down to the hip row (the arms hang in front of the back of the head; the cloak hangs behind it). Sleep frames (head left after TEMPLATE_V3's rotation rule): head = hair box widened by head_margin.side and by the neck rows to the right; arms = from the hair box's right edge for sleep_arms_share of the template body length; legs = the last sleep_legs_share of the template body length ending at the figure's right edge. torso = the whole figure box, only for tops in bare_torso_tops (loincloth: bare chest or a chest band; hide wrap: a one-shoulder wrap leaving the other shoulder and upper chest bare). Fur cloak looks get no torso region: their tunic and cloak cover it.
